description: 186,427 culverts on Ministry of Transportation roads, with material, size, installation date and fish-passage attributes. Published by Construction and Maintenance (Province of British Columbia) as [Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Culverts](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/ministry-of-transportation-mot-culverts) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: CULVERT_ID
table:columns.description: CULVERT ID is a system generated identifier to ensure row uniqueness. This is a primary key field.

table:columns.name: CHRIS_CULVERT_ID
table:columns.description: CHRIS CULVERT ID contains the identifier of the culvert inventory item derived by the CHRIS application. E.g., 2455305

table:columns.name: ADMIN_UNIT_CODE
table:columns.description: ADMIN UNIT CODE contains the MoT Service Area identifier. There are 28 service areas in MoT's jurisdiction. Each Service Area represents a geographic area within the province. E.g., 13

table:columns.name: ADMIN_UNIT_NAME
table:columns.description: ADMIN UNIT NAME contains the MoT Service Area Name identifier.

table:columns.name: CROSS_SECTION_POSITION
table:columns.description: CROSS SECTION POSITION contains the cross sectional position of the culvert in relationship to the road, E.g., Ditch - Left, Right of Way - Left, Shoulder - Left etc.

table:columns.name: CULVERT_TYPE
table:columns.description: CULVERT TYPE contains a physical description of the type of culvert, E.g., down drain, entrance, roadway etc.

table:columns.name: CULVERT_DIAMETER
table:columns.description: CULVERT DIAMETER contains the physical measure of the diameter of the culvert in millimetres. E.g., 100, 2999, etc.

table:columns.name: CULVERT_MATERIAL
table:columns.description: CULVERT MATERIAL contains a physical description of the type of material the culvert is made of. E.g., Concrete, Galvanized, Plastic etc.

table:columns.name: CONFINED_SPACE_IND
table:columns.description: CONFINED SPACE IND indicates whether the Culvert is enclosed or partially enclosed, not designed for human occupancy, and large enough so the worker can enter e.g., Yes or No

table:columns.name: INSTALLATION_DATE
table:columns.description: INSTALLATION DATE indicates the date that the culvert was installed (YYYY-MM-DD).

table:columns.name: FISH_SENSITIVE_CODE
table:columns.description: FISH SENSITIVE CODE indicates whether a Culvert contains fish bearing water or not. e.g., Yes, No or Unknown

table:columns.name: FISH_PASSAGE_TYPE
table:columns.description: FISH PASSAGE TYPE contains a physical description of the fish passage type, E.g., bottomless, baffle, fish ladder etc.

table:columns.name: GRATE_CODE
table:columns.description: GRATE CODE indicates whether a culvert has a grate or not. e.g., Yes, No or Unknown

table:columns.name: FLAP_GRATE_CODE
table:columns.description: FLAP GRATE CODE indicates whether a culvert has a flap grate or not. e.g., Yes, No or Unknown

table:columns.name: CHRIS_ANCHOR_SECTION_ID
table:columns.description: CHRIS ANCHOR SECTON ID contains the CHRIS application internal unique identifier for the anchor section segment. E.g., 2777363

table:columns.name: EVENT_LOCATION
table:columns.description: EVENT LOCATION contains the Measure for the Culvert along the Anchor Section. Measures are in Kilometers. e.g., 42.200

table:columns.name: HIGHWAY_NUMBER
table:columns.description: HIGHWAY NUMBER is the MoT Numbered Route identifier only populated when the culvert is located on a MoT Numbered route. E.g., 99 If the culvert is not on a numbered route the field is blank.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: OBJECTID is a required attribute of feature classes and object classes in a geodatabase.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA is a binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
